options.name: criteria
options.description: The criteria used for validation of I(data). For the type of criteria refer to the documentation of individual validate plugins.

options.name: data
options.description: Data that will be validated against I(criteria). For the type of data refer to the documentation of individual validate plugins.

options.name: engine
options.description: The name of the validate plugin to use. The engine value should follow the fully qualified collection name format, that is <org-name>.<collection-name>.<validate-plugin-name>.
